question: From which of the following rivers do the Dhuadhar falls originate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhuadhar Falls** originate from the **Narmada River**.
 
• Located in the **Jabalpur district** of Madhya Pradesh, the Dhuadhar Falls are a prominent tourist attraction.
 
• The name "Dhuadhar" comes from the Hindi word "Dhua," meaning smoke, which reflects the misty appearance of the falls due to the forceful water flow.
 
• The falls are part of the **Marble Rocks** region where the Narmada River flows through a narrow gorge, creating a spectacular view.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Narmada River** is one of the major rivers in central India and is often referred to as the lifeline of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is the fifth-longest river in India and the largest west-flowing river in the country.
 
• The Narmada River is also considered one of the seven holy rivers of India, and it has significant cultural and religious importance.
 
• The river basin supports a rich biodiversity and various ecosystems that are crucial for the environment and local communities.
